rules.title: No discrimination based on rental assistance (source of income)
rules.requirement: In Boston, landlords cannot refuse to rent to you or treat you differently because you use rental assistance, such as a Section 8 voucher, social security disability voucher, or veterans voucher.
rules.requirement_es: En Boston, los propietarios no pueden negarse a rentarle ni tratarle de forma diferente porque usted usa asistencia de alquiler, como un vale de Sección 8, un vale de discapacidad del seguro social o un vale para veteranos.
rules.coverage_text: All housing rentals in the City of Boston; protected classes include rental assistance (e.g., Section 8 vouchers).
rules.quote: The landlord tells you they don't accept rental assistance. This includes Section 8 vouchers, social security disability vouchers, and veterans vouchers.
